title: Bukhari for strengthening Apni Party’s grassroots presence across Jammu province

ai.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Apni Party president Syed Mohammad Altaf Bukhari emphasized the need for a political alternative that addresses people's concerns in Jammu and Kashmir, highlighting the restoration of full statehood as a key demand.

facts.claim: Jammu and Kashmir Apni Party president Syed Mohammad Altaf Bukhari said the prevailing political situation in Jammu and Kashmir demanded a responsible, progressive and people-oriented political alternative
facts.quote: Jammu and Kashmir Apni Party president Syed Mohammad Altaf Bukhari on Wednesday said the prevailing political situation in Jammu and Kashmir demanded a responsible, progressive and people-oriented political alternative that could rise above regional and political divisions and consistently champion the genuine interests of the people.

facts.claim: Bukhari highlighted the restoration of full statehood to Jammu and Kashmir as a significant political demand
facts.quote: Highlighting the importance of democratic empowerment, Bukhari reiterated that the restoration of full statehood to Jammu and Kashmir remained a significant political demand.

ai.background_note: The Apni Party is advocating for Jammu and Kashmir's restoration of statehood, which was lost in 2019 when it was split into two union territories.
